arguments.summary: A credential theft incident was initiated via a phishing email that delivered a malicious PowerShell payload. The attacker used encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook, loaded an unsigned DLL via rundll32, and established a Cobalt Strike beacon to C2 server 198.51.100.23. Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to a file server using compromised credentials. The source host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) was compromised under user CORP\jsmith.
